summary: Frontend-only testing of the BYDAUTO.AE static landing page. Verified root URL iframe rendering, hero content, offers counter, modal open/close/Escape, form submission graceful error (Web3Forms placeholder key -> expected CORS/network failure -> #formerr shown, submit re-enabled), 8-language selector (EN/FR/AR/JA verified translate; AR sets dir=rtl while title stays LTR; JA shows Japanese), ?lang= URL forcing, SEO section (4 points), 4 advantages, and mobile responsiveness at 390x844 (no horizontal overflow, modal usable). All critical flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY in /app/frontend/public/bydauto.html is still a placeholder ('YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY_HERE'). Submissions currently fail (CORS on preflight to api.web3forms.com). This is expected per the review request but must be replaced with a real key before going live.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static page at /bydauto.html; root shows iframe (data-testid=domain-preview-iframe). Use ?static to disable animations, ?open to auto-open modal, ?lang=xx to force language. Web3Forms key is placeholder so form submission is expected to fail with CORS/network error and #formerr shown — this is by design.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found. Web3Forms failure is by design (placeholder key).
